summary: Story 3 implementation matches the approved requirements, architecture, design review, and plan. No actionable findings.
decisions: Prerequisites: all five handoffs are valid, have the expected stages, and have status completed. The orchestrator recorded the human approvals: requirements with the trim amendment, architecture, design review, plan, and the docs Option B trims.

Model: Employee and CreateEmployeeRequest add an optional nullable String department. It has no validation annotation, so POST without department still returns 201 with a null department. Existing name and email validation is unchanged. Department is stored as given, with no trimming.

Filter: EmployeeService.findAll(department) returns all employees when the parameter is omitted. Otherwise it trims the value and returns an empty list if the result is blank. Otherwise it matches with equalsIgnoreCase, exactly and not partially, and skips employees whose department is null. This agrees with the approved trim amendment and the blank/unknown to 200 [] decision. The controller uses @RequestParam(required = false).
Preservation: GET /api/employees/{id}, the 404 body, and the POST 201/400 behaviour are unchanged in the controller code.

OpenAPI: the department query parameter is documented as optional with a description. The department property appears on both the Employee and CreateEmployeeRequest schemas. OpenApiDocumentationTests asserts the parameter is a non-required string query parameter in OpenAPI, and asserts the schema properties.

Docs: the current docs/api-docs.md agrees with the code and the approved trims. It covers filter semantics (trim, case-insensitive, exact, blank gives [], unknown gives []), the null department, and the POST department stored as given. The trims are human-approved and are not defects.

Tests: coverage includes case-insensitive and exact matching, a trimmed query, blank and whitespace queries, unknown values, department stored as given, and POST without department. The existing assertions were kept. The recorded evidence is 12 tests with 0 failures, run by the developer and re-run by the orchestrator. I did not run tests, since I have no shell.
No actionable findings were found. .github/instructions/verification.instructions.md is out of scope. This review does not replace Verification.
